title: VectorSmuggle: Steganographic Exfiltration in Embedding Stores and a Cryptographic Provenance Defense
why_relevant: Studies steganographic exfiltration via embedding perturbations in RAG vector stores and proposes a cryptographic provenance defense. Tangentially related to adversarial corruption of RAG pipelines but focused on data exfiltration/integrity rather than retrieval robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Threat model is insider exfiltration, not poisoning/injection that misleads RAG outputs; orthogonal to robustness under unreliable evidence.
